translations.WIKI_CARD_STORE_DESC: The Card Store lets you purchase and rip card packs using Champion Credits. All unlocked cards permanently expand your account's collection.
translations.WIKI_CARD_STORE_PT_1: Starter Packs: Foundational one-time packs containing high-volume cards (50 Bronze, 25 Silver, 15 Gold) to establish your collection.
translations.WIKI_CARD_STORE_PT_2: Guaranteed Career Appearance: Whenever a new card is unlocked, a copy is queued to appear with 100% priority in your upcoming career draws.
translations.WIKI_CARD_STORE_PT_3: Card Rarities: Bronze (Common), Silver (Advanced), Gold (Elite), Legendary (World-Class), and Iconic (Era-defining stars).
translations.WIKI_CARD_STORE_PT_4: Pity & Rarity Protection: Every pack drawn accumulates bad-luck protection, guaranteeing higher rarity drops over consecutive opens.
translations.WIKI_PLAYER_CARD_DESC: Your Player Card displays your current Overall Rating (OVR), Potential (POT), primary position, sub-positions, and attribute modifiers.
translations.WIKI_PLAYER_CARD_PT_1: Overall Rating (OVR): Dynamically weighted from your 6 core attributes according to your primary pitch position.
translations.WIKI_PLAYER_CARD_PT_2: Potential (POT): Represents your natural developmental ceiling. Can be expanded through elite coaching and genetic activation.
translations.WIKI_PLAYER_CARD_PT_3: Sub-Positions & Versatility: Unlocking secondary positions allows you to play in tactical variations without out-of-position penalties.
translations.WIKI_PLAYER_CARD_PT_4: Positive & Negative Modifiers: Temporary boosts from training and equipment, or fatigue/injury penalties from congested fixtures.
translations.WIKI_DEV_DESC: Investing free stat points into attributes follows an authentic diminishing returns curve, rewarding specialized and balanced training.
translations.WIKI_DEV_PT_1: Progressive Efficiency Tiers: Attributes from 0-20 grow at +5.0 levels per point, while elite ratings (90-95) require 10 points per level.
translations.WIKI_DEV_PT_2: The 100 Stat Break: Attributes maxed at 99 can undergo an ultimate 100-point investment to achieve permanent Stat Break Immortality (100).
translations.WIKI_DEV_PT_3: Youth Growth Spurts: Between ages 15-18, young prodigies experience spontaneous physical attribute surges at the end of each season.
translations.WIKI_DEV_PT_4: Club Training Facilities: Upgrading your club's training center in the store provides passive stat points each season.
translations.WIKI_MATCH_DESC: Every match simulates 90 minutes of authentic football action, punctuated by decisive Key Moments where your personal skill decides the outcome.
translations.WIKI_MATCH_PT_1: Match Rating (1.0 to 10.0): Calculated from on-ball events, goals, assists, key passes, defensive duels, and tactical positioning.
translations.WIKI_MATCH_PT_2: Quick-Time Event (QTE) Precision: During decisive moments, time the moving cursor into the green zone for +0.25 rating bonuses.
translations.WIKI_MATCH_PT_3: Penalty & Free-Kick Mechanics: High shooting attributes widen the target precision zone on high-stakes set pieces.
translations.WIKI_MATCH_PT_4: Tactical Interventions: Choose between bold risk-taking plays or conservative team-first passes to sway tight derby matches.
translations.WIKI_YOUTH_DESC: Beginning your career at 15 in a youth academy requires balancing match experience, physical development, and travel adaptation.
translations.WIKI_YOUTH_PT_1: Big Club Adaptation: Moving to an elite academy incurs Year 1 penalties (-20 Stamina, 80% Chemistry cap) due to long travel and competition.
translations.WIKI_YOUTH_PT_2: Year 2 Progress: Adaptation penalties reduce to -10 Stamina and 90% Chemistry cap as you settle into the squad.
translations.WIKI_YOUTH_PT_3: Full Integration: Year 3 lifts all adaptation penalties completely, granting 100% Chemistry ceiling and full stamina recovery.
translations.WIKI_YOUTH_PT_4: Professional Graduation: Signing a senior professional contract at 17 or 18 immediately clears all youth adaptation restrictions.
translations.WIKI_CONTRACTS_DESC: Managing contract length, weekly wages, release clauses, and agent representation dictates your financial freedom and transfer options.
translations.WIKI_CONTRACTS_PT_1: First Pro Contract: Converted from academy prospect status to paid professional with guaranteed weekly wages.
translations.WIKI_CONTRACTS_PT_2: Agent Skill & Commission: Experienced agents secure higher signing bonuses and unlock prestigious European contract clauses.
translations.WIKI_CONTRACTS_PT_3: Release Clauses: Fixed buyout fees protect you from being held against your will when European giants come knocking.
translations.WIKI_CONTRACTS_PT_4: Saudi & Mega Offers: High-reputation players in their prime or veteran years can attract lucrative multi-million euro contracts.
translations.WIKI_NATIONAL_DESC: Players with dual citizenship can represent their birth nation or ancestral heritage until permanently locked by competitive caps.
translations.WIKI_NATIONAL_PT_1: Youth vs Senior Caps: Friendly matches and youth tournaments do not lock your international allegiance permanently.
translations.WIKI_NATIONAL_PT_2: Permanent Lock: Making an appearance in an official senior continental qualifier, Copa America, Euros, or World Cup irrevocably locks your nation.
translations.WIKI_NATIONAL_PT_3: National Reputation: Leading your country to continental or global glory dramatically multiplies your Ballon d'Or voting score.
translations.WIKI_NATIONAL_PT_4: National Team Tournaments: Group stage draws, official draw ceremonies, and knockout brackets follow realistic FIFA tournament formats.
translations.WIKI_ECONOMY_DESC: Weekly wages flow into your bank account, allowing you to invest in personal coaching, pro equipment, vehicles, and real estate.
translations.WIKI_ECONOMY_PT_1: Bank Balance: Earn weekly salaries and performance bonuses from clean sheets, goals, and trophy triumphs.
translations.WIKI_ECONOMY_PT_2: Equipment & Taping: Buy ankle and knee taping in the store for multi-month injury resistance during crucial title runs.
translations.WIKI_ECONOMY_PT_3: Lifestyle & Luxuries: Purchase real estate, sports cars, and luxury watches to elevate your fame and commercial sponsor appeal.
translations.WIKI_ECONOMY_PT_4: Direct Purchase System: All store upgrades are bought directly using player cash with clear visual item categorization.
translations.WIKI_GENETICS_DESC: A rare, high-cost specialized sports science procedure available once per career to break through developmental stagnation.
translations.WIKI_GENETICS_PT_1: One-Time Operation: Genetic activation can only be undergone once across a player's entire football career.
translations.WIKI_GENETICS_PT_2: Ceiling Expansion: Unlocks +3 to +7 potential points above your natural limit, revitalizing veteran and prime players.
translations.WIKI_GENETICS_PT_3: Rare Mutation Traits: Chance to unlock rare physical traits like Iron Lungs, Explosive First Step, or Ambipedal Weak Foot.
translations.WIKI_GENETICS_PT_4: Financial Cost: Requires substantial career wealth (€100,000,000) or special genetic booster cards to activate.
translations.WIKI_CHEMISTRY_DESC: Dressing room spirit directly influences match simulation odds, teammate assist rates, and manager trust.
translations.WIKI_CHEMISTRY_PT_1: Team Cohesion: High chemistry grants bonus passing accuracy and defensive resilience in high-pressure matches.
translations.WIKI_CHEMISTRY_PT_2: Manager Relationship: High trust guarantees starting lineup selection even after occasional subpar performances.
translations.WIKI_CHEMISTRY_PT_3: Vacation & Recovery: Off-season holidays restore mental fatigue and refresh dressing room camaraderie.
translations.WIKI_CHEMISTRY_PT_4: Conflict Resolution: Negative events and transfer requests can temporarily disrupt locker room morale.
translations.WIKI_STREET_DESC: Honing your skills on asphalt and cage pitches develops raw flair, unpredictable dribbling, and street toughness.
translations.WIKI_STREET_PT_1: Street Card Draws: Special street cards offer potent offensive modifiers with unconventional risk-reward trade-offs.
translations.WIKI_STREET_PT_2: Skill Moves & Flair: Improves agility and close control in tight penalty box situations.
translations.WIKI_STREET_PT_3: Physical Resilience: Street matches build toughness, reducing matchday fatigue accumulation over time.
translations.WIKI_STREET_PT_4: Underground Reputation: Gain unique street nicknames and fan following that follow you onto professional pitches.
